facts.text: The Arkansas Promise Plus scholarship covers remaining tuition and mandatory fees for up to four years for qualifying Arkansas high school graduates with family income under $70,000.

sources.title: Arkansas Promise Plus
sources.quote: The Arkansas Promise Plus is renewable for up to four years to cover any remaining tuition and mandatory fees (Athletic and Student Activity Fees) after federal Pell Grants, state scholarships and A-State Academic Scholarships

sources.title: Arkansas Promise Plus
sources.quote: Family income is less than $70,000 (based on the Adjusted Gross Income or AGI from federal income tax form)
